sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日新闻通讯《DealBook》的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以现场观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I think we're on our way to Boundbrook, New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 我想我们正在去往新泽西州邦德布鲁克的路上。

sentences.en: We're in, I believe we're in, if I'm reading my map correctly, we're in South Boundbrook.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在……如果我的地图没看错的话，我们现在在南邦德布鲁克。

sentences.en: It looks like we're about 15 minutes south of Bedminster, which is where the president's golf club and country house are.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们位于贝德明斯特以南大约15分钟车程的地方，总统的高尔夫俱乐部和乡间别墅就在那里。

sentences.en: Are we here?
sentences.zh: 我们到了吗？

sentences.en: Uh, this, if the address is, it's supposed to be a greenhouse, yeah?
sentences.zh: 呃，这个，如果地址没错的话，应该是一个温室，对吧？

sentences.en: Okay, I think we'll just get out.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想我们直接下车吧。

sentences.en: Let's just tell her we are here.
sentences.zh: 我们跟她说一声我们到了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Welcome to Vicky's.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到维琪的家。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: I'm obviously not Vicky.
sentences.zh: 我显然不是维琪。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: If you come back after being away a week, you're apologizing that it's not as used as it ought to be.
sentences.zh: 如果你离开一个星期再回来，你就会道歉说这里没有想象中那么经常使用。

sentences.en: Yeah, we told her when it's in power.
sentences.zh: 对，当它掌权时我们告诉过她。

sentences.en: Why don't we sit there?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不坐那边？

sentences.en: I don't want to get away.
sentences.zh: 我不想走开。

sentences.en: So how this is going to work, Miriam, is Michael's going to ask questions in English as he knows how to speak.
sentences.zh: 米丽娅姆，接下来的流程是这样的：迈克尔会用他会说的英语提问，

sentences.en: And then if you would help translate and then...
sentences.zh: 然后如果你能帮忙翻译，接着……

sentences.en: I'm going to be just kind of a conversation.
sentences.zh: 这将只是一场随性的对话。

sentences.en: We'll make it work.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它进行好的。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 干杯。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Vicky welcomed you all into her home.
sentences.zh: 维琪欢迎大家来到她的家。

sentences.en: She says it's a humble home.
sentences.zh: 她说这是一个简陋的家。

sentences.en: She's an immigrant.
sentences.zh: 她是个移民。

sentences.en: She loves this country, and she'd like to share with you why she's here.
sentences.zh: 她热爱这个国家，并想和你们分享她为什么会在这里。

sentences.en: Well, I want to thank you because we're grateful to be here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想谢谢你们，因为我们很感激能来到这里。

sentences.en: I guess my first question is just how are you doing?
sentences.zh: 我想我的第一个问题是，你最近过得怎么样？

sentences.en: How are you holding up given everything that's just happened in the past few days?
sentences.zh: 鉴于过去几天发生的一切，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Vicky said that she's feeling better because she has left this place where she was working.
sentences.zh: 维琪说她感觉好多了，因为她已经离开了她工作过的那地方。

sentences.en: She is relieved that she's come out of this place where she felt fear.
sentences.zh: 她松了一口气，终于离开了那个让她感到恐惧的地方。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Last week, Victorina Morales came forward and said that for the last five years, she had been working as an undocumented immigrant at President Trump's golf club in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 上周，维多丽娜·莫拉莱斯站出来说，在过去的五年里，她一直作为无证移民在特朗普总统位于新泽西州的高尔夫俱乐部工作。

sentences.en: A couple of days ago, we visited her in her home with Times immigration reporter Miriam Jordan,
sentences.zh: 几天前，我们和《纽约时报》移民记者米丽娅姆·约旦一起去她家里拜访了她，

sentences.en: who first broke the story, Friday, December 14th.
sentences.zh: 她于12月14日星期五首次独家报道了这则新闻。

sentences.en: Okay, I want to know more about your experience before you came to the United States and where you came from.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想更多地了解你来到美国之前的经历，以及你来自哪里。

sentences.en: So maybe you can describe the place where you are from.
sentences.zh: 所以也许你可以描述一下你的家乡。

sentences.en: He says that she comes from the countryside, from a place where her house was all alone in a particular area.
sentences.zh: 他说她来自农村，来自一个房子在特定区域孤零零伫立的地方。

sentences.en: To go from one place to another, because it wasn't electricity, people used a flashlight to guide the way.
sentences.zh: 从一个地方到另一个地方，因为那里没有电，人们用手电筒来指引方向。

sentences.en: Ah, that's what you turned this water bottle into, a flashlight.
sentences.zh: 啊，这就是你把这个水瓶变成的东西，一个手电筒。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Vicky said that she comes from a very poor background, extremely humble.
sentences.zh: 维琪说她出身非常贫寒，极其简陋。

sentences.en: Yo comía frijoles, espinaca, nada de carne, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我吃豆子、菠菜，什么肉都没有，不，不。

sentences.en: So at what age did you decide to leave Guatemala?
sentences.zh: 那你是在什么年龄决定离开危地马拉的？

sentences.en: And what exactly motivated you to leave?
sentences.zh: 又是什么具体原因促使你离开的？

sentences.en: Cuando yo me vine para acá, tenía yo 35 años.
sentences.zh: 我来这里的时候35岁。

sentences.en: She was 35 years old when she came to the United States.
sentences.zh: 她来到美国时35岁。

sentences.en: It was 1999.
She wanted to give her children a better life, and she'd heard that you could make good money in America.
sentences.zh: 她想给孩子们更好的生活，而且她听说在美利坚可以赚到好钱。

sentences.en: So her husband came ahead, and she followed.
sentences.zh: 所以她丈夫先走了，她随后跟上。

sentences.en: Hice de Guatemala para acá un mes y quince días.
sentences.zh: 我从危地马拉到这里花了一个月零十五天。

sentences.en: It took her a month and a half to journey from Guatemala all the way to the border in California.
sentences.zh: 她花了足足一个半月的时间，才从危地马拉一路走到加利福尼亚州的边境。

sentences.en: Pasé todo México caminando, caminando, caminando, caminando.
sentences.zh: 我走过了整个墨西哥，走啊，走啊，走啊，走啊。

sentences.en: She came caminando, caminando, caminando, walking, walking, walking the whole way through Mexico.
sentences.zh: 她一路走着，走着，走着，走过，走过，走过整个墨西哥。

sentences.en: She said that they only hopped in a car when they were chased on occasion to escape.
sentences.zh: 她说他们只有在偶尔被追赶时才会跳上汽车来逃跑。

sentences.en: On arrival at the border, she spent those last two weeks waiting for the right moment to cross.
sentences.zh: 到达边境后，她度过了最后两周，等待着过境的最佳时机。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Cuando yo llegué a Los Ángeles, allí me recibió el coyote.
sentences.zh: 当我到达洛杉矶时，蛇头在那里接了我。

sentences.en: When she crossed the border in California, she was met by a coyote or a smuggler who took her to Los Ángeles
sentences.zh: 当她穿过加州边境时，她遇到了一个“郊狼”（蛇头），对方把她带到了洛杉矶，

sentences.en: where he bought her a plane ticket and told her that she would be on her way to meet her husband in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 在那里给她买了一张机票，并告诉她将去新泽西州与丈夫汇合。

sentences.en: She said that she felt this great sense of fulfillment and satisfaction of finally being in this country.
sentences.zh: 她说她感到一种强烈的成就感和满足感，终于来到了这个国家。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说，

sentences.en: Thank God.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝。

sentences.en: Gracias a Dios.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝。

sentences.en: Thank God I'm here.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝我来到这里了。

sentences.en: And this might seem like a small matter, but how did you get on a plane at that point or do anything without documents?
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能是一件小事，但当时你是怎么坐上飞机或者在没有证件的情况下做任何事的？

sentences.en: Or did you get documents?
sentences.zh: 还是说你弄到了证件？

sentences.en: Allá en Los Ángeles, el muchacho que me mandó en avión, él me dio dos papelitos así.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，那个送我坐飞机的小伙子，他给了我两张这样的小纸片。

sentences.en: In Los Ángeles, the gentleman who helped her get on the plane gave her two small pieces of paper, as she puts it.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，正如她所说，那个帮她坐上飞机的男子给了她两张小纸条。

sentences.en: And he told her that they're good for her to get work.
sentences.zh: 并告诉她这些对她找工作很有用。

sentences.en: And when you apply for any job, this is what you need.
sentences.zh: 当你申请任何工作时，这就是你需要的。

sentences.en: So keep them.
sentences.zh: 所以收好它们。

sentences.en: And Miriam, what's your understanding of what these documents were?
sentences.zh: 米丽娅姆，据你了解这些证件是什么？

sentences.en: It's quite clear that the documents were a fake Social Security card and a green card or a permanent residence card, which immigrants typically need to present to secure work.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这些证件是假的社会安全卡和绿卡或永久居民卡，移民通常需要出示这些来确保找到工作。

sentences.en: And it sounds like that may have kind of come along with whatever the transaction was with the Coyote.
sentences.zh: 听起来这可能与和“郊狼”达成的某种交易有关。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's a package deal in which, you know, this network of people brought her across the border, supplied her with documents, got her a plane ticket,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这是一个打包服务，你知道的，这个人口网络把她带过了边境，为她提供了证件，给她买了一张机票，

sentences.en: and made sure she ended up in her home right here in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 并确保她最终落脚在新泽西州的这个家里。

sentences.en: And how, Vicky, did you end up working at the Trump National Bedminster golf course, the golf club?
sentences.zh: 维琪，你是怎么最后在特朗普国家贝德明斯特高尔夫球场，也就是那个高尔夫俱乐部工作的？

sentences.en: A friend of Vicky's told her that there was work at the golf club and that the pay was very good.
sentences.zh: 维琪的一个朋友告诉她，高尔夫俱乐部有工作，而且工资非常好。

sentences.en: Vicky, how did you know that this would be a place that would be okay with employing someone like you who did not have legal status?
sentences.zh: 维琪，你怎么知道这是一个会愿意雇用你这样没有合法身份的人的地方？

sentences.en: Well, she asked her friend, you're sure you don't need good papers to work there?
sentences.zh: 嗯，她问她的朋友，你确定在那里工作不需要好的证件吗？

sentences.en: Because she knew a powerful man owned that golf club.
sentences.zh: 因为她知道一个有权势的男人拥有那个高尔夫俱乐部。

sentences.en: This is the first time I think I can translate.
sentences.zh: 我想这是我第一次能够翻译。

sentences.en: He said, that's not important.
sentences.zh: 他说，那不重要。

sentences.en: We have many immigrants here without papers.
sentences.zh: 我们这里有很多没有证件的移民。

sentences.en: It's fine, it's fine.
sentences.zh: 没关系，没关系。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: As this process continues, at some point, does someone ask you for papers of any kind?
sentences.zh: 随着这个流程的进行，在某个时刻，有人向你索要任何形式的证件吗？

sentences.en: Vicky arrived for her interview on a Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 维琪在一个周日上午去面试。

sentences.en: The housekeeping supervisor drove up in a golf cart and asked her to hop in and they went to visit some of the suites on the property that are around the pool
sentences.zh: 客房部主管开着高尔夫球车驶来，让她跳上车，然后他们去参观了物业里围绕着游泳池的一些套房，

sentences.en: and the supervisor asked Vicky what kind of work she knew how to do and she said, well, you know, I can dust, I can scrub, I can sweep.
sentences.zh: 主管问维琪会做什么样的工作，她说，嗯，你知道的，我会除尘，我会擦洗，我会扫地。

sentences.en: And at a certain point, she said, I don't speak English, I don't have papers.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，她说，我不会说英语，我没有证件。

sentences.en: And she said, oh, that's okay.
sentences.zh: 主管说，哦，没关系。

sentences.en: Here we want people who want to do the work.
sentences.zh: 在这里我们想要的是想干活的人。

sentences.en: We're not worried about the papers.
sentences.zh: 我们不担心证件。

sentences.en: And that was the supervisor
sentences.zh: 那就是客房部的

sentences.en: of housekeeping.
sentences.zh: 主管。

sentences.en: Vicky, I wonder if you could describe the golf club for me, what your impression of it is.
sentences.zh: 维琪，我想请你描述一下那个高尔夫俱乐部，你对它的印象是什么。

sentences.en: What does it look like?
sentences.zh: 它看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: When Vicky first, you know, started working there, she thought, oh, it's just such a beautiful, special place.
sentences.zh: 当维琪刚开始在那里工作时，她想，哦，这简直是一个美丽、特别的地方。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: God, thank you for affording this opportunity.
sentences.zh: 天哪，感谢您提供这个机会。

sentences.en: There wasn't that anything in particular impressed me, but just the fact that it was such a beautiful place and that somebody like Vicky, she's saying, who's so poor
sentences.zh: 并没有什么特别的事让我印象深刻，只是它是一个如此美丽的地方，而且像维琪这样的人——她说，如此贫穷，

sentences.en: with barely any education, to be in such a place was such a privilege.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有受过什么教育，能身处这样一个地方真是一种特权。

sentences.en: And what did you do in this job?
sentences.zh: 你在工作中都做些什么？

sentences.en: What were your daily tasks?
sentences.zh: 你每天的任务是什么？

sentences.en: You know, she did everything there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她在那儿什么都做。

sentences.en: She vacuumed, she dusted, she cleaned the suite.
sentences.zh: 她吸尘，她除尘，她打扫套房。

sentences.en: She cleaned Ivanka's house.
sentences.zh: 她打扫伊万卡的房子。

sentences.en: She cleaned her toilets.
sentences.zh: 她打扫她的厕所。

sentences.en: She washed her clothes.
sentences.zh: 她洗她的衣服。

sentences.en: She ironed them.
sentences.zh: 她熨衣服。

sentences.en: She washed the clothes of Mr. Trump.
sentences.zh: 她洗特朗普先生的衣服。

sentences.en: She made his bed.
sentences.zh: 她整理他的床铺。

sentences.en: Vicky said that only three of the housekeepers were allowed in Mr. Trump's house, and she was one of them.
sentences.zh: 维琪说，只有三名客房服务员被允许进入特朗普先生的房子，而她是其中之一。

sentences.en: A great source of pride.
sentences.zh: 这真是一件极其荣耀的事。

sentences.en: Meaning that you were very good at your job.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你工作非常出色。

sentences.en: She said that she knows she did a good job, and in fact,
sentences.zh: 她说她知道自己工作做得很好，事实上，

sentences.en: Mr. Trump, when he encountered her on three occasions, praised her for the good work that she did.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生在三次偶遇她时，都称赞她工作干得好。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: She'll never forget the time that she was washing the windows of the pro shop when, you know, suddenly Mr. Trump showed up right behind her, got out of his golf cart
sentences.zh: 她永远不会忘记那次她正在擦高尔夫球具店的窗户，你知道的，突然特朗普先生出现在她身后，从高尔夫球车上下来，

sentences.en: and grabbed her rag.
sentences.zh: 抢走了她手里的抹布。

sentences.en: And proceeded to wipe the top of the windows since she's very short.
sentences.zh: 由于她个子很矮，他便帮着擦拭窗户顶部。

sentences.en: She was having trouble reaching them, and he gave her a big assist, then asked her her name.
sentences.zh: 她当时够不着，他帮了大忙，然后问了她的名字。

sentences.en: And how do you call it?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字来着？

sentences.en: Victorina.
sentences.zh: 维多丽娜。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh, this is good, good, good.
sentences.zh: 噢天哪，这很好，很好，很好。

sentences.en: Told her she was doing a good job and gave her a $50 tip.
sentences.zh: 告诉她她工作干得不错，并给了她50美元小费。

sentences.en: Gracias, lego en español.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，我用西班牙语说。

sentences.en: Y me hace así y se fue.
sentences.zh: 他对我比划了一下就走了。

sentences.en: Montó el casito y se fue.
sentences.zh: 她放下小箱子就走了。

sentences.en: So in 2015, this person who has been your employer, your boss's boss's boss, the guy who owns the place, he starts to run for the office of president.
sentences.zh: 所以在2015年，这个人，也就是你的雇主、你老板的老板的老板、这个地方的老板，他开始竞选总统。

sentences.en: How aware were you day to day of the fact that he was running for president and what his message was as a candidate?
